{"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":1866,"ns":0,"title":"Magic Shield","revisions":[{"revid":1182867,"parentid":1182866,"timestamp":"2026-05-07T06:32:56Z","sha1":"e8fba34a6a2da517971ebe6dc33273bdd02a58de","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"''This page is about the '''spell''' Magic Shield. For the [[Special Condition]], see [[Magic Shield (Condition)]]. {{Infobox Spell|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Magic Shield | spellid = 44 | type = Instant | subclass = Support | words = utamo vita | premium = no | mana = 50 | levelrequired = 14 | cooldown = 14 | cooldowngroup = 2 | voc = [[Druid]]s and [[Sorcerer]]s. | effect = Damage taken reduces [[Mana]] instead of [[HP|Hit Points]]. Duration is 180 seconds. | notes = While this spell is active, all damage received will be taken from the character's mana instead of HP. The [[File:Magic Shield Spell Icon.gif|Magic Shield Icon]] icon will appear in the conditions bar. Mana spent by blocking damage with magic shield does not increase [[Magic Level]]. The Magic Shield only absorbs a limited amount of damage before breaking. When this mana is depleted, the spell effect disappears. The amount of mana it absorbs depends on the character's [[Level]] and [[Magic Level]], including equipment and skill boosts active at the moment the spell is cast, according to this formula (rounded up to the next whole number), where L is your level and M is your magic level: Magic Shield Capacity = 7M + 7.6L + \max\{300, 0.4L \} If you have unlocked the Enhanced Magic Shield Conviction Perk on the Sorcerers' [[Wheel of Destiny]], then the formula is: Magic Shield Capacity = 8M + 8.6L + \max\{300, 0.4L \} Recasting the spell restores the shield to its maximum value. While the spell is on cooldown, mages can renew the shield by using a [[Magic Shield Potion]]. The Magic Shield can be removed by casting the [[Cancel Magic Shield]] spell. | history = Before the [[Updates/8.7|Winter Update 2010]] this spell was very useful for [[Paladin]]s as it can effectively double one's hit points. Before the [[Updates/12.55|Vocation Adjustments Update]], the Magic Shield had the same amount of mana the character currently had instead of a fraction of it. Furthermore, with this update the spell cooldown was increased from 2 to 14 seconds while its duration was reduced from 200 to 60 seconds. On the following week, with [[Updates/12.60.10468|Update 12.60.10468]], the Magic Shield duration was increased to 180 seconds. | libraryname = magicshield | librarytext = The study of magic is a time-consuming activity that requires many years of dedicated research and academic work. For this reason those who have chosen the path of magic usually neglect physical exercise, training their minds rather than their bodies. As a result, spell casters are typically frail and cannot endure injuries the way skilled warriors can. However, sorcerers and druids reacted to this problem in their typical manner, looking for magical means to protect their weak bodies in battle. The Magic Shield spell was the result of this research. By casting this spell it is possible to deflect any physical or magical damage by using sheer will power. Unfortunately, however, the mental strain caused by the spell is tremendous, and any damage that is deflected by the magical shield is directly taken from the caster's mana reserve. For this reason the spell should be used wisely. While there is little point in using it against weak monsters, Magic Shield has saved the life of many a spell caster when battling strong monsters that otherwise would have killed him in a second. }}"}}}]},{"pageid":78085,"ns":0,"title":"Life Leech","revisions":[{"revid":1101811,"parentid":1100517,"timestamp":"2025-05-04T17:01:12Z","sha1":"66676a50d17637d0d74a2495be9dcfe881913b9c","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"{{Version Widget|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | implemented = 10.94 }} '''Life Leech''', introduced with [[Updates/10.94]], is a way to receive health points from your opponent during fighting. It can be done by [[Imbuing]] certain equipment with [[Basic Vampirism]], [[Intricate Vampirism]] or [[Powerful Vampirism]], by enhancing skills through the [[Wheel of Destiny]], or wearing equipment that has [[Augments]] that provide life leech. It is worth noting that [[Prey System|Damage Prey]]s do not affect the leech. == History == * It was initially available via [[Charging]] (which was removed with [[Updates/11.40]]) and later also by [[Imbuing]] certain equipment. * It used to be called '''Hit Points Leech''' before the name was changed to Life Leech. {{seealso|usage=article|Critical Hits|Mana Leech|Imbuing}} [[Category:Game Terms]]"}}}]},{"pageid":84163,"ns":0,"title":"Damage Reflection","revisions":[{"revid":1131993,"parentid":1100606,"timestamp":"2025-10-07T15:47:33Z","sha1":"9e0e8ada13deed7779b9411eafad4f9bfcb70699","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"{{Version Widget|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | implemented = 11.40.5409 | seealso = }}'''Damage Reflection''' is a passive ability that some creatures have and that players can have through some equipment. It's similar to the [[Parry|Parry Charm]]. __TOC__ == Damage Reflection by Players == Characters can receive the ability to reflect damage through some equipment listed below. Damage reflection in this case has some special rules: * The reflected damage cannot be greater than 1% of the maximum [[HP|hit points]] of the attacker. ** For example, if the combined damage reflection of all worn equipment is 80, it will still only reflect a maximum of 50 damage on creatures with 5000 health points. ** This 1% limit can be exceeded through the use of [[Prey System|Damage Boost Prey]] on a selected creature, so the maximum amount of damage reflection can be higher. * Damage reflection is only triggered by [[melee]] damage. * It does not affect [[Bosses]]. * It is shown as dark purple text. So 32 damage would show up as 32. === List of Items that have Damage Reflection === {{DPL Table| | headers= !Name!!!!Vocation!!Min. Level!!Attributes | table_class = wikitable sortable | table_style = text-align:center; | tablerow = [[%TITLE%]]¦¦[[File:%TITLE%.gif]]¦¦%%,%%,%% | sortcol = 1 | no_results = There are no results. | categories = Items with Damage Reflection | uses_template = Template:Infobox Object | includes= {Infobox Object}:vocrequired:levelrequired:attrib }} == Damage Reflection by Creatures == Creatures with this ability will reflect a certain percentage of the damage they receive to the aggressor. This percentage can be much greater than 100%, meaning a lot more damage than was initially dealt. The Creature's resistances is not affected by this, some creatures reflect the damage of elements they are immune against, while others reflect damage of elements they are neutral to. When you deal damage to a creature with damage reflection (for example neutral with 10% reflection), the following messages are displayed on the [[Server Log Channel]]: :{{Server Message|You lose 115 hitpoints due to an attack by ''Creature''. (damage reflection)}} :{{Server Message|''Creature'' loses 1150 hitpoints due to your attack.}} __TOC__ === List of Creatures that use Damage Reflection === {| class = "wikitable sortable" style="text-align:center;" ! The resistances can affect this. === List of Bosses that use Damage Reflection === {| class = "wikitable sortable" style="text-align:center;" ! Name !! !! Reflection % !! Damage Type |- | [[The Armored Voidborn]] || {{Ilink|The Armored Voidborn}} || 100% || All |- | [[The Source of Corruption]] || {{Ilink|The Source of Corruption}} || 15% || All |- | [[Zarcorix of Yalahar]] || {{Ilink|Zarcorix of Yalahar}} || 300% || All |- | [[Sand Vortex]] || {{Ilink|Sand Vortex}} || 100%? || All |- | [[Force Field]] || {{Ilink|Force Field}} || 10-20% || All |- | [[Faceless Bane]] || {{Ilink|Faceless Bane}} || 85% || [[Death Damage]] |- | [[The Scourge of Oblivion (Reflective)]] || {{Ilink|The Scourge of Oblivion (Reflective)}} || 3000~% || All |- | [[Bragrumol]] || {{Ilink|Bragrumol}} || 95% || [[Death Damage]] |- | [[Xogixath]] || {{Ilink|Xogixath}} || 55% || [[Fire Damage]] |- | [[Leiden]] || {{Ilink|Leiden}} || ?% || All? |- | [[Neferi the Spy]] || {{Ilink|Neferi The Spy}} || 11.4% || [[Death Damage]] |}"}}}]},{"pageid":94083,"ns":10,"title":"Template:Infobox Object/Documentation","revisions":[{"revid":1204204,"parentid":1202724,"timestamp":"2026-08-31T00:49:33Z","sha1":"c84180ef4c519a9f7a56495d6fb1c744ed356e3b","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"{{Documentation Subpage}} {{Documentation Page | notes = This infobox is used on pages of Objects, which are almost everything you see in the Game Window. | parameters = {{Parameter Table | {{Parameter Row|name|The name of the object on TibiaWiki, which should be in most cases the same name of the page. If a page has disambiguation brackets, such as [[Giant Shimmering Pearl (Brown)]], this parameter should be the same. This parameter is used to retrieve the corresponding image gif file, and it's also very important in DPL tables.

This name should always use initial capitals using the same rules as the ones for [[TibiaWiki:Standards|page names]].|required=yes}} | {{Parameter Row|article|The article used for countable singular objects. It should only be one of 'a', 'an' or empty. The article 'the' should not be used, since when it exists it is actually part of the name. This parameter is used to properly build the look message.}} | {{Parameter Row|actualname|The name of the object as it appears in game when looked at. Most object names are all lower-case, however, some have upper-case initials when a proper name is mentioned, such as [[Vessel of Ferumbras]] (''vessel of Ferumbras''). Although this parameter is not required and the template will use the ''name'' in lower case instead, it's recommended to be added to avoid confusions and mistakes. This parameter is also used to build the look message.}} | {{Parameter Row|plural|The plural of the actualname parameter.}} | {{Parameter Row|itemid|The Object ID(s) of the object. The IDs can be found in the dat file, which can only be examined using specific tools. Multiple IDs can be used in one page if and only if all the other object properties are the same. In such cases, IDs should be given in a comma-separated list.

For instance, some walls or floor tiles are very similar, having the same name and same other properties, and creating one page for each would be tedious and repetitive, so a single page with all IDs is preferrable. If two tile objects are similar but have different ''mapcolor''s, on the other hand, it would be better to have them on different pages so the properties can be correctly displayed.|required=yes}} | {{Parameter Row|objectclass|The main "Class" of the object, as per TibiaWiki's [[Objects]] grouping. As per the [[TibiaWiki:Projects/Merge Items and Objects|infobox merge project]], however, the definition of classes and types are still under review.|required=yes}} | {{Parameter Row|primarytype|The main "Type" of the object, as per TibiaWiki's [[Objects]] grouping. As per the [[TibiaWiki:Projects/Merge Items and Objects|infobox merge project]], however, the definition of classes and types are still under review.|required=yes}} | {{Parameter Row|secondarytype|The secondary "Type" of the object, as per TibiaWiki's [[Objects]] grouping. As per the [[TibiaWiki:Projects/Merge Items and Objects|infobox merge project]], however, the definition of classes and types are still under review.}} | {{Parameter Row|tertiarytype|The tertiary "Type" of the object, as per TibiaWiki's [[Objects]] grouping. As per the [[TibiaWiki:Projects/Merge Items and Objects|infobox merge project]], however, the definition of classes and types are still under review.}} | {{Parameter Row|cooldown|The [[cooldown]] before the object can be used again.}} | {{Parameter Row|flavortext|Also known as 'description', this is the extra text that appears when looking at an object. Line breaks can be added, if necessary, using
, but only if the line break also exists in the original description.}} | {{Parameter Row|words|If this item is a rune, set to the rune's displayed words (e.g. thunderstorm runes ("adori mas vis")).}} | {{Parameter Row|sounds|A list of {{Message|type=sound|sounds}} an object can make when interacted with. When at least one sound exists, the [[Template:Sound]] should be used, having each sound as a parameter. For example, on [[Stuffed Dragon]]:
| sounds        = {{Sound List|Fchhhhhh!|Zchhhhhh!|Groaaarrr.... *cough*|Aaa... CHOO!|You... will.... burn!!}}

Sounds are displayed under the Object's look message.}} | {{Parameter Row|implemented|The update version in which the object was implemented. This is a required parameter, since obviously all objects were implemented at some version, with some rare [[Updates/--|exceptions]] (objects that were/are only seen in [[Test Server]]s). Only numbers and dots should be used, i.e. ''12.20.8834''.|required=yes}} | {{Parameter Row|lightradius|If the object gives light, the radius of this light can be put here as an integer number.}} | {{Parameter Row|lightcolor|If the object gives light, the color value of this light can be given as an integer number. See [[Template:RGB Light Color]] for a full list.}} | {{Parameter Row|destructible|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate of the object is destructible, which means it can be destroyed by e.g. using a [[Melee]] weapon.}} | {{Parameter Row|immobile|Use 'yes' or 'no' to indicate if the Object cannot be moved around in the map. This is one of the most important parameters of the template in terms of object characterization. It should always be given, and can easily be verified in game or the client files.

It is important to remember that some objects, such as [[Store]] carpets, are ''immobile'', even though they can be transformed into mobile objects when used (in their rolled-up versions). For these cases, separate pages for each version of the carpet are necessary. |required=yes}} | {{Parameter Row|walkable|Whether or not an object can be walked over. All pickupable objects can be walked over (even though some have the ''blockspath'' property as well, which prevents map-clicking walking over them).}} | {{Parameter Row|walkingspeed|If it's a tile, the walking speed is how long it takes to cross the tile. Only use when walkable is set to "yes".}} | {{Parameter Row|unshootable|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate of the object is unshootable, in other words, if it blocks projectiles (distance weapons or runes) to be shot through.}} | {{Parameter Row|blockspath|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate of the object blocks the path.}} | {{Parameter Row|pickupable|Use 'yes' or 'no' to indicate if an object can be picked up, i.e., put into a container and carried by characters. [[:Category:Pickupable Objects|Pickupable Objects]] are popularly simply known as 'items', a distinction that was once the rule in TibiaWiki as well. This is however just a single property, and many properties are shared between non-pickupable and pickupable objects.

A pickupable object must also not be immobile, obviously. On the other hand, there are non-pickupable objects which can be moved, such as [[Furniture]]. Moreover, some of these movable non-pickupable items are ''wrappable'', which transform them into pickupable [[Furniture Kit]]s or [[Decoration Kit]]s. For these reasons, associating this parameter with others must be done with care to avoid wrong assumptions. |required=yes}} | {{Parameter Row|holdsliquid|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate of the object can hold liquid, which is mostly true for [[Liquid Containers]].}} | {{Parameter Row|usable|This simple parameter is used to inform whether or not the object can be "used", or simply interacted with. There are two different types of use interaction, "normal" use in which the action happens on the first click and "use-with" in which the interaction will be between the object and something else (another object, a character, the map, etc). Currently, there's no difference between them in TibiaWiki.}} | {{Parameter Row|writable|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate of the object can be written on, which is true for some documents.}} | {{Parameter Row|rewritable|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate of the object can be rewritten once it has been written.}} | {{Parameter Row|writechars|The amount of characters which can be written in the object.}} | {{Parameter Row|wrappable|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate if the object can be wrapped into a [[Furniture Kit]] or a [[Decoration Kit]].}} | {{Parameter Row|task_item|Use "yes" or "no" to indicate if the object is a task item (e.g. used for a delivery task). Case-insensitive. If omitted, it defaults to "no" and is not shown. When set to yes, the page is added to [[:Category:Task Items]].}} | {{Parameter Row|levelrequired|Minimum level to use the equipment and benefit from all of its perks. Note that some types of equipment can be equipped even if the character doesn't have the required level, however, in that case skill bonus and other properties won't work, the attack will be lowered, etc. If there is no level requirement, the parameter should be omitted.}} | {{Parameter Row|vocrequired|The object's vocation requirement. Use the text as displayed in-game, i.e. plural vocation names, commas to separate all except the last one which uses the text "and". If the object is used only by players with no vocation, use without. For example: * [[Prismatic Legs]] - paladins * [[Draken Boots]] - knights and paladins * [[Great Mana Potion]] - sorcerers, druids and paladins * [[Star Ring]] - without}} | {{Parameter Row|mlrequired|The object's magic level requirement. Must be used on all articles about [[Runes]]. If the magic level requirement for a rune is 0, set the parameter's value to 0.}} | {{Parameter Row|basepower|The object's base power. Created to be used on all articles about [[Runes]].}} | {{Parameter Row|hands|The amount of hands the object requires to be worn. Two or One. Include parameter only if the object is a weapon and is wielded in the weapon slot.}} | {{Parameter Row|weapontype|The weapon type of the object. Include if the object is a weapon and is wielded in the weapon slot. You can use: * Axe * Club * Sword * Fist * Wand * Rod * Distance}} | {{Parameter Row|attack|The [[Physical Damage]] attack value of a weapon. Some weapons can have 'atk: 0', this should be explicit. Not to be used for wands and rods, there is a parameter for those.}} | {{Parameter Row|fire_attack|The [[Fire Damage]] attack value of a weapon, if it has any. Omit if the weapon doesn't deal this type of damage. Not to be used for wands and rods, there is a parameter for those.}} | {{Parameter Row|earth_attack|The [[Earth Damage]] attack value of a weapon, if it has any. Omit if the weapon doesn't deal this type of damage. Not to be used for wands and rods, there is a parameter for those.}} | {{Parameter Row|defense|The defense value of the object. Include if the object is a shield or weapon, omit otherwise.}} | {{Parameter Row|defensemod|The defense modifier value of the object. | augments      = Eternal Winter -> Powerful Impact, Terra Wave -> Powerful Impact
}} | {{Parameter Row|imbuements|A comma-separated list of all imbuements that require this object. This is '''NOT''' for objects that are imbuable, see '''imbueslots'''.}} | {{Parameter Row|upgradeclass|A number from 1 to 4 indicating the Classification of the item in the [[Exaltation Forge]] upgrade system.}} | {{Parameter Row|enchantable|Include if the object could be [[Enchanting|enchanted]] at Holy Shrines before [[Summer Update 2017]]; omit otherwise. Other forms of enchantment should not have this parameter, e.g. Rainbow Shield. If included, it must be set to yes.

This parameter is only kept for historical purposes, since we can keep a record of what was enchantable back in the day the system existed.}} | {{Parameter Row|enchanted|Include if the object was the result of enchanting. If included, it must be set to yes. Same status as ''enchantable''.}} | {{Parameter Row|range|The range of distance weapons, wands and rods. Include if the object is a distance weapon and the value isn't 0; omit otherwise.}} | {{Parameter Row|hit_mod|The +hit% modifier of the distance weapon. Include if the object is a distance weapon and the value isn't 0; omit otherwise.}} | {{Parameter Row|armor|The armor value of the object. Include this parameter only if the object has armor.}} | {{Parameter Row|resist|The elemental resistance of the object. Include this parameter only if the object has resistance to some element. Perfect Shots are applied to only a single target, and only when the target is exactly at the range defined by the equipment that grants this modifier. The modifier is primarily found on [[Quivers]] for [[Paladin]]s, but can also be found in some [[Wands]]. An example for an item with this type of modifier would be a bow with "+25 bonus at range 5" and "Range:6". A player wielding this bow and attacking a target at range 4 or 6, dealing 240 damage, would deal 265 damage to a target at range 5. If AoE [[Missiles|arrows]] are used, only the primary target will be dealt the additional damage. It has been confirmed by users in the community that Perfect Shot bypasses raid boss [[Mitigation]], which makes it valuable for rare raids such as [[Ghazbaran]], although it can be hard to apply properly due to the amount of players and effects on the screen.[https://discord.com/channels/404607250607636481/404607576806785035/1296892858342576210 TibiaWiki's Official Discord] == Items with Perfect Shot == === Quivers === {{#dpl: | tablesortcol = 1 | noresultsheader =''There are no results to display'' | mode=userformat | category=Quivers | notcategory=Item Types | titlematch= | nottitlematch= | namespace= | includematch=/perfect shot/ | include={Infobox Object}:name:attrib:vocrequired | table=width="100%" class="sortable wikitable",Name,,Attributes,Vocations | tablerow=align="center" valign="middle"{{!}}[[File:%%.gif]],align="center"{{!}}%%,align="center"{{!}}%%,align="center" | allowcachedresults=true }} === Wands === {{#dpl: | tablesortcol = 1 | noresultsheader =''There are no results to display'' | mode=userformat | category=Rods¦Wands | notcategory=Item Types | titlematch= | nottitlematch= | namespace= | includematch=/perfect shot/ | include={Infobox Object}:name:attrib:vocrequired | table=width="100%" class="sortable wikitable",Name,,Attributes,Vocations | tablerow=align="center" valign="middle"{{!}}[[File:%%.gif]],align="center"{{!}}%%,align="center"{{!}}%%,align="center" | allowcachedresults=true }} === References === [[Category:Game Terms]] [[Category:Game Elements]]"}}}]},{"pageid":107867,"ns":0,"title":"Cleave","revisions":[{"revid":1095106,"parentid":1095104,"timestamp":"2025-03-13T16:49:23Z","sha1":"32e92161f8f1da5ded74645b7d6c4265e47960d7","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"{{Version Widget|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | implemented = 12.70.10953 }} '''Cleave''', introduced with [[Summer Update 2021]], is a way to deal more damage than usual. Cleave is a modifier applied to a few [[Knight]] weapons, dealing damage to two targets immediately at the side of a character's main target. For Cleave, [[Charms]] and [[Life Leech]]/[[Mana Leech]] will not be triggered on secondary targets. Secondary targets with [[Damage Reflection]] also reflect the Cleave damage back to the player. An example for damage calculation would be an [[Axes|axe]] with "Atk:10 physical + 50 fire" and "10% Cleave". When the main target would receive 10 [[Physical Damage]] and 50 [[Fire Damage]] (before reduction), this would lead to the secondary targets receiving 10% of that: 1 physical damage and 5 fire damage. It is then that the creature's defense might further reduce the actual damage they suffer. === Items with Cleave === {{#dpl: | mode=userformat | category=Weapons with Cleave | uses = Template:Infobox Object | include={Infobox Object}:name:attrib:vocrequired | table=width="100%" class="sortable wikitable",Name,,Attributes,Vocations | tablerow=align="center" valign="middle"{{!}}[[File:%%.gif]],align="center"{{!}}%%,align="center"{{!}}%%,align="center" | tablesortcol = 1 | noresultsheader =''There are no results to display'' }} [[Category:Game Terms]] [[Category:Game Elements]]"}}}]}]}}
